query: I was walking around the old town here earlier and stopped at this tiny family-run bakery, they had these flaky almond croissants that were still warm from the oven, I ate two right there and even bought a couple extra to bring back to my hotel later. The shop owner and I ended up chatting for almost twenty minutes, they told me all about how their family has been running the bakery for three generations, and they even gave me a free little jar of homemade jam as a souvenir. Oh right, the reason I’m calling: my SMS app isn’t working at all right now, I think the permission for it might be broken, I already got a notification that I’ve exceeded my data limit, and I’m currently abroad with roaming turned off so I don’t run up extra charges, can you help me figure this out?
